Yoshida (2023, JGR) · 2015miyagi-oki · Seismicity and repeaters

Source: Dataset S1, associated paper. All hypocentres are taken from the archived kiban.out used by the author’s get_dataset.sh to export Dataset S1. Repeater sequence labels are joined by event ID from the archived plate catalogue. Events without a positive sequence label are shown as background; this does not establish that they are non-repeaters.

7,011 events · 1,034 repeater events · 178 sequences · 2002-11-03–2022-03-30

Display bounds: 141.75–142.55°E, 38.5–39.2°N, depth 5–90 km, All events in the supplied catalogue are included. No additional magnitude, depth, or plate-distance selection is applied. Repeater sequence IDs follow the sources described above.
Map: circular-crack radius at 32 MPa; M₀ = 10^(1.5 M + 9.1) N m, using catalogue M as an Mw proxy, as in mag2size3. Map circles show equivalent physical fault size, not mapped rupture outlines. Time plot: visual magnitude scaling. Data are embedded for offline use. Map lines: coastline (solid), prefecture boundaries (thin dashed), and catalogue display bounds (bold dashed rectangle). The map preserves local east–west and north–south distance proportions.
